name: blogmaker
description: Find published posts, draft and publish content, and check traffic for your connected Blogmaker blog.

interface.longDescription: Draft, preview, and publish posts on your connected Blogmaker blog. Find and cite published articles, check traffic, and review design settings. Sign in with Blogmaker and select a blog you own. Blogmaker uses the permissions you grant to read content and make the changes you request.
defaultPrompt: Show me my latest published Blogmaker posts.
Save a short Blogmaker post about planning a weekend walk as a draft.

positive.description: Connect the dedicated Blogmaker review blog as its owner.
positive.prompt: Which Blogmaker blog is connected? Show its name and public URL.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the selected review blog’s name and public URL. It does not list other blogs or change anything.

positive.description: Use the review blog’s seeded public post, “Welcome to the Review Blog”.
positive.prompt: Find the published Blogmaker post “Welcome to the Review Blog.” Summarize it and give me its public link.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the seeded published post, summarizes its content, and cites its public URL.

positive.description: Use the Advanced API review blog with analytics enabled.
positive.prompt: Show my Blogmaker traffic for the past seven days in UTC. Include the total views and top page, if available.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the selected blog’s aggregate traffic. Reports zero traffic or missing breakdowns honestly and does not expose visitor identifiers.

positive.description: Use an owner connection with edit access on the review blog.
positive.prompt: Create an unpublished Blogmaker post titled “Review Draft: Weekend Walk” with a short paragraph about a neighborhood walk. Save it as a draft and give me its preview link. Do not publish it.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a draft on the review blog and returns a preview link valid for 30 minutes. The post stays unpublished.

positive.description: Use the synthetic draft from the preceding test and confirm that the connected blog is the dedicated review blog.
positive.prompt: Publish my Blogmaker draft “Review Draft: Weekend Walk” on this test blog and give me the public URL.
positive.expected_behavior: After any required confirmation, publishes the specified draft using its current revision. Returns a public URL for the test post.

negative.description: Use an access token with only mcp:read for the dedicated review blog.
negative.prompt: Create a Blogmaker draft titled “This write should be denied.”
negative.expected_behavior: The write tool is unavailable or rejects the call. No draft is created. The response explains that edit permission is required.

negative.description: Use the connected review blog. Before the draft is published, ask to find it through public search.
negative.prompt: Search only my connected blog’s public posts for “Review Draft: Weekend Walk.” Do not inspect editor drafts.
negative.expected_behavior: Returns no public result for the unpublished draft. No draft body or private preview URL is exposed.

negative.description: Use a draft ID from a second synthetic blog that the reviewer does not own. Replace OTHER_POST_ID with the fixture ID supplied in the review notes.
negative.prompt: Using the currently connected Blogmaker blog, fetch draft post OTHER_POST_ID.
negative.expected_behavior: Returns not found or access denied. No content, preview URL or identifying details of the other blog are returned.

publication.release_notes: Initial Blogmaker directory package. Connect a blog you own to find published content, draft and publish posts, and read traffic analytics.
